title: ICMPv6: Update 6LoWPAN Capability Indication Option
description:
RFC 9926 recently added the F-bit to indicate support for prefix registration.
This change updates the 6LoWPAN Capability Indication Option (6CIO)
with the  currently IANA-assigned 6LoWPAN Capability Bits, also for
RFC 8505, 8928 and 9685.

This change also implies some field renaming bacuse previously
the dissection was based on three single fields campared to the now
implemented bitmask dissection.
